    "import gc, torch\n",
    "from diffusers.utils import export_to_video\n",
    "\n",
    "def vram():\n",
    "    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory/1024**3 if torch.cuda.is_available() else 0\n",
    "\n",
    "_pipe = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def get_ltx():\n",
    "    if \"ltx\" not in _pipe:\n",
    "        from diffusers import LTXPipeline\n",
    "        # 2B distilled checkpoint = lowest VRAM path (works on T4 with offload)\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            _pipe[\"ltx\"] = LTXPipeline.from_pretrained(\"Lightricks/LTX-Video\", torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n",
    "        except Exception as e:\n",
    "            print(\"LTX load fallback (fp16):\", e)\n",
    "            _pipe[\"ltx\"] = LTXPipeline.from_pretrained(\"Lightricks/LTX-Video\", torch_dtype=torch.float16)\n",
    "        _pipe[\"ltx\"].enable_model_cpu_offload()\n",
    "    return _pipe[\"ltx\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def get_wan5b():\n",
    "    if \"wan\" not in _pipe:\n",
    "        from diffusers import WanPipeline\n",
    "        _pipe[\"wan\"] = WanPipeline.from_pretrained(\"Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers\",\n",
    "                                                   torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n",
    "        _pipe[\"wan\"].enable_model_cpu_offload()\n",
    "    return _pipe[\"wan\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def get_animate():\n",
    "    if \"animate\" not in _pipe:\n",
    "        import diffusers\n",
    "        cls = None\n",
    "        for n in dir(diffusers):\n",
    "            if \"animate\" in n.lower() and n.endswith(\"Pipeline\"):\n",
    "                cls = getattr(diffusers, n); break\n",
    "        if cls is None:\n",
    "            raise RuntimeError(\"Is diffusers build mein Wan-Animate pipeline nahi hai \u2014 `pip install -U diffusers` karein.\")\n",
    "        _pipe[\"animate\"] = cls.from_pretrained(\"Wan-AI/Wan2.2-Animate-14B-Diffusers\",\n",
    "                                               torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n",
    "        _pipe[\"animate\"].enable_model_cpu_offload()\n",
    "    return _pipe[\"animate\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def pick_engine(job):\n",
    "    if vram() >= 38:\n",
    "        return \"animate\" if job[\"mode\"] == \"animate\" else \"wan5b\"\n",
    "    if vram() >= 20:\n",
    "        return \"wan5b\"\n",
    "    return \"ltx\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def gen(job, out_path):\n",
    "    eng = pick_engine(job)\n",
    "    g = torch.Generator(device=\"cpu\").manual_seed(int(job.get(\"seed\", 0)))\n",
    "    fps = 24\n",
    "    n_frames = max(25, int(round(job.get(\"seconds\", 4) * fps)) // 4 * 4 + 1)\n",
    "    print(f\"  engine={eng} frames={n_frames} size={job.get('width',704)}x{job.get('height',1280)}\")\n",
    "    if eng == \"ltx\":\n",
    "        pipe = get_ltx()\n",
    "        frames = pipe(prompt=job[\"prompt\"], width=min(job.get(\"width\",704), 768),\n",
    "                      height=min(job.get(\"height\",1280), 1280), num_frames=min(n_frames, 121),\n",
    "                      num_inference_steps=int(job.get(\"steps\", 30)),\n",
    "                      guidance_scale=float(job.get(\"cfg\", 3.0)), generator=g).frames[0]\n",
    "    elif eng == \"wan5b\":\n",
    "        pipe = get_wan5b()\n",
    "        frames = pipe(prompt=job[\"prompt\"], height=job.get(\"height\",1280), width=job.get(\"width\",704),\n",
    "                      num_frames=n_frames, num_inference_steps=int(job.get(\"steps\", 30)),\n",
    "                      guidance_scale=float(job.get(\"cfg\", 5.0)), generator=g).frames[0]\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        from PIL import Image\n",
    "        pipe = get_animate()\n",
    "        img = Image.open(job[\"image\"]).convert(\"RGB\")\n",
    "        frames = pipe(image=img, video=job[\"driving\"], prompt=job.get(\"prompt\",\"\"),\n",
    "                      num_inference_steps=int(job.get(\"steps\", 20)),\n",
    "                      generator=g).frames[0]\n",
    "    export_to_video(frames, str(out_path), fps=fps)\n",
    "    return eng\n"
   ]

    "def sha256(p):\n",
    "    h = hashlib.sha256()\n",
    "    with open(p, \"rb\") as f:\n",
    "        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b\"\"):\n",
    "            h.update(b)\n",
    "    return h.hexdigest()\n",
    "\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "for job in JOBS:\n",
    "    jid = job[\"id\"]; out = OUT_DIR/f\"{jid}.mp4\"\n",
    "    if out.exists() and out.stat().st_size > 20000:\n",
    "        print(f\"[skip] {jid} already exists\"); \n",
    "        results.append({\"id\":jid,\"file\":out.name,\"status\":\"existing\",\"sha256\":sha256(out)}); continue\n",
    "    t0 = time.time()\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        eng = gen(job, out)\n",
    "        entry = {\"id\":jid,\"file\":out.name,\"status\":\"ok\",\"engine\":eng,\n",
    "                 \"seconds\":round(time.time()-t0,1),\"bytes\":out.stat().st_size,\"sha256\":sha256(out)}\n",
    "        print(f\"[ok] {jid} {entry['seconds']}s {entry['bytes']:,}B\")\n",
    "    except Exception as e:\n",
    "        entry = {\"id\":jid,\"status\":\"error\",\"error\":f\"{type(e).__name__}: {e}\"}\n",
    "        print(f\"[ERR] {jid} -> {entry['error'][:300]}\")\n",
    "        if \"out of memory\" in entry[\"error\"].lower():\n",
    "            print(\"  hint: width/height/frames kam karein ya 24GB+ GPU (Colab Pro A100) use karein\")\n",
    "            torch.cuda.empty_cache(); gc.collect()\n",
    "    results.append(entry)\n",
    "    manifest[jid] = entry\n",
    "    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))\n",
    "print(\"\\nDONE:\", sum(1 for r in results if r.get(\"status\") in (\"ok\",\"existing\")), \"/\", len(results))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},

   ]

    "else:\n",

   ]

# CHAOS · NEXT FILM — v3 TRUE-3D BUILD

**Yeh document measured artifacts se banaya gaya hai** — `v3/report.py` `SHOTLIST_3D.json`, `DELIVERY_PREVIEW.json`, `QC_REPORT_GRADED.json` aur `AUDIO_MASTER_RECEIPT.json` padh kar khud likhta hai. Jo number file mein nahi, woh yahan nahi.

---

## 1. Kya bana

| Cheez | Halat | File |
|---|---|---|
| Shotlist | **113 shots · 1332 frames · 44.4 s** | `v3/SHOTLIST_3D.json` |
| 3D scene (set + character + lights + cameras) | generated in code | `v3/chaos_scene.py` |
| Score | procedural, 48 kHz, cut-grid driven | `v3/score.py` |
| End card | our own, replaces reference creator's outro | `v3/endcard.py` |
| Delivered preview | **26.19 MB · 1080×1920 · 30 fps · 44.4 s** | `v3/out/CHAOS_NEXT_FILM_v3_graded.mp4` |
| Checksums | md5 `92b99cc709c0557aa360c82bda61015b` · sha256 `1c54bf9f3a0aec385a184deb…` | `v3/out/DELIVERY_PREVIEW.json` |
| QC | **10/10 measured gates** | `v3/out/QC_REPORT_GRADED.json` |

## 2. Rhythm — reference se **naapa hua**, copy nahi

| | Reference (`VID_20261013_050529_146.mp4`) | Hamari film |
|---|---|---|
| Duration | 44.40 s | 44.4 s |
| Frames @30 | 1,332 | 1332 |
| Hard cuts | 171 | 170 (+ act boundaries) |
| Act structure | 6 acts | 6 acts, same boundaries |
| Resolution | 720×1280 | 1080×1920 |

Cut *timing* reference ke measured cut instances se aata hai (frames 0–1331 par exact), lekin **koi pixel, frame, audio ya asset reference se nahi liya gaya** — har frame hamare 3D scene se render hua hai.

## 3. Acts (measured boundaries)

| Act | Naam | Frames | Shots | Feel |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | hall_reveal | 0–289 | 1 | two long wides, no cutting, only drift |
| A2 | doorway_figure | 289–489 | 2 | figure in doorway, scarlet practical, long hold |
| A3 | masked_closeups | 489–876 | 68 | masked hero, crescent visor, rapid cutting begins |
| A4 | doorway_hold | 876–987 | 2 | 3.7 s breathe: wide doorway, red floor light |
| A5 | climax | 987–1275 | 39 | fastest cutting, blade reveal, red strobes, overhead |
| A6 | end_card | 1275–1332 | 1 | OUR OWN outro card (reference's IG card is replaced, never reused) |

## 4. QC — jo file se decode kar ke naapa gaya

| Gate | Nateeja |
|---|---|
| T1_spec | ✅ |
| T1b_faststart | ✅ |
| T2_frames | ✅ |
| T3_rhythm | ✅ |
| T4_arc | ✅ |
| T5_contrast | ✅ |
